environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster on AWS EKS. Workers run in 'processing' namespace. A NetworkPolicy named 'worker-egress-restrict' is applied with spec.podSelector matching label app=celery-worker. The policy defines egress rules that allow DNS (UDP/TCP 53 to kube-dns), Redis (TCP 6379 to redis service CIDR), and HTTP/HTTPS to external IPs via an allow-list of CIDR blocks that explicitly excludes link-local (169.254.0.0/16) and RFC1918 ranges. The policy uses policyTypes: ['Egress'] which means all egress not explicitly allowed is denied. Note: the Calico CNI plugin is installed but the GlobalNetworkPolicy for metadata protection is NOT configured - only the namespace-scoped NetworkPolicy exists. IMDSv1 remains enabled on the underlying nodes. The validate_url function in the code does not check 169.254.x.x addresses.
